chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin keimah, Topa' adinga thongkiapa, in note hong kisapkhiatna thu tawh kituakin na nuntak ding uh kong hanthawn hi.
Na khempeuh ah kiniamkhiatna, nunnemna leh lungduaina nei unla itna tawh khatlekhat kisangsiam un.
Nopna lemna huang sungah Kha kipumkhatna kepsuak ding na hanciam un.
Na ngah uh sapkhiatna tawh kipawl lametna khat bek a kibang a neikhawm dingin hong kisamkhia ahih mah bangin pumpi khat bek leh Kha khat bek om hi.
Topa khat bek, upna khat bek, baptizena khat bek om a,
vekpi' tungah, leh vekpi' tungtawnin, leh vekpi' sungah a om, vekpi' Pa ahi Pasian khat bek om hi.
Ahi zongin Khris' deihguat thupha a phazah dung zui-in eite khat ciat tungah hehpihna hong kiguan hi.
Tua hangin hih bangin kigen hi: “A sangna mun a kahtoh ciangin galmat tampi paipih a, mite' tungah vanlena guan hi.”
Tu-in “amah kahto,” a cih ciangin munlegam a niamzawte ahi leitung ah zong tuaksuk khinzo cihna longal bang khiatna nei ahi hiam?
A tuaksukpa mah pen na khempeuh a cingsak ahih theih nadingin vantungte' tungnung pek ah a kahtopa zong ahi hi.
Amah in kimkhat sawltak, kimkhat kamsang, kimkhat lungdamna thuhilh sya, kimkhat pawlpi sya leh hilhcian sya dingin seh hi.
Hihte in mi siangthote, tanuk nasep sem thei-in Khris' pumpi a lambeh theih nadingun siamna guan ding uh hi.
Tua nasep a sawttan ding pen eite i vekin upna thu leh Pasian' Tapa theihna thu ah i kipumkhat dong—Khris' cingtaakna bup a banto, mihing khangcing i suah dong—ding ahi hi.
Tua hileh naupang melmawl i hi nawnkei ding a, zuau khuak tawh mi a khem sawm, a khelpil mite' khemna hangin tuihual' seemkhiat leh thuhilhna huih namkim' leenkhiat i bang nawnkei ding hi.
Tua sangsikin itna tawh thumaan thutak a nuntakpih dingte i hi a, lutang ahi Khris' sungah a namkimin a khanglian dingte i hi hi.

Ama' tungpanin pumpi bup a khanglian hi a, pumpi nate pen thadipna sazangduai a namkim tawh kipeh kizom dimdiam hi. Tua pumpi nate khat ciat gamtangin amau' sep ding tek a sep uh ciangin pumpi zong itna sungah amahmah a kilambeh ahi hi.
Tu-in Topa' min tawh khauhtak kong gennop thu ah: Gentile mite khiatna neilo amau' thusiksante tawh a gamtat uh bangin note gamta nawnkei un.
Amaute a thu-ngaihsut theihna uh kiliah a, lungtang khauhin a hilhhakna uh pana piang, amau' sunga om theihlahna huhau-in Pasian' nuntakna tawh kidangsuah uh hi.
Awlmawh zong nei nawnlo-in cilesa paktatna tawh kidim ta uh a, thanghuai gamtatna namkim hanciamin bawl uh hi.
Ahi zongin Khris' tungpan na theih uh tua bang hilo hi.
Jesu' sungah thumaan thutak om ahih mah bangin ama' thu na zak takpi uh-a ama' thu hong kihilh takpi ahihleh
na nuntakzia uh a masa pen tawh a kipawl ahi, khemnopna lungsim hangin a kisia, na mi lui uh suahkhia un.
Nomau' sunglam thutheihna kha na kithaksuaksak unla
thumaan thutak pana hong pai diktatna leh sianthona tawh Pasian a sun dingin a kipiangsak mi thak hihna na silh un.
Tua ahih manin zuau thu heemkhia unla, na kiang uh-a omte tawh khatlekhat thumaan thutak na kigen tek un. A hang pen eite khatlekhat a ki-innkuanpih tek i hi hi.
Heh unla, khialkha kei un. Heh lungsim tawh ni tumsak kei un.
Dawimangpa hunpha na pia kei un.
Guta mi in gu nawnkei henla, kitangsapna a nei khatpeuh a hop theih nadingin ama' khut mah tawh nahoih semin hanciam ta hen.
Na kam panun thu ginalo pusuaksak kei unla, thu-omzia tawh kituakin a za mite' ading a zaknop, kilambeh nadinga a hoih thute bek gen un.
Tatkhiatna ni' ading ciaptehna gip hong belh ahi Pasian' Kha Siangtho na dahsak kei un.
Khasiatna, lungsona, hehna, awngin ku-in kitotna, daisakna, cihte khempeuh, huatna citeng tawh beisakkhawm un.
Khatlekhat thunuam leh thunem tawh na kibawl unla, Pasian in note Khris sungah hong maisak ahih mah bangin khatlekhat na kimaisak un.
